dcterms:description: A large-scale dataset consisting of real anonymous questions from the Bing search engine and 8.8 million candidate passages for passage reranking task. The training set contains about 500 thousand positive query-passage pairs and each query has one relevant passage on average. The development set and evaluation set contains 6980 queries and 6837 queries respectively, where the relevance labels are provided for the development set only.
dcterms:title: MS MARCO Passage Ranking

dcterms:description: A newswire collection used by TREC 2004 Robust track, which comprises 250 queries and 0.5 million documents. The dataset is used for evaluating document ranking methods.
dcterms:title: TREC Robust04
